<p>Action cams make great gifts, or if you're a photographer, a solid addition to your kit. Black Friday deals usually mean you can pick up new cameras and accessories for less, and this year is no different. One of the best deals we've found is on the <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:1;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0FCTS9WMV&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=04598562-b569-4148-b80c-9d6909156167&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=GoPro+Hero+13+Black&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAR-hwLtasMFncaDBzt2ZHKoZOK1DKtcQA5U0KktaNCNp&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FGoPro-HERO13-Black-Ecommerce-Packaging%2Fdp%2FB0FCTS9WMV%2F" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/GoPro-HERO13-Black-Ecommerce-Packaging/dp/B0FCTS9WMV/">GoPro Hero 13 Black</a> action cam, which is down to $310 for Black Friday. That's a discount of 23 percent or $90.</p> 
<p>This model topped our list of the <a data-i13n="cpos:2;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/cameras/best-action-camera-130017459.html">best action cameras</a>, and for good reason. It's a fantastic device with all kinds of <a data-i13n="cpos:3;pos:1" href="https://www.engadget.com/cameras/gopro-hero-13-black-release-date-price-hands-on-impressions-130027978.html">bells and whistles</a>. It's the most versatile Hero camera that GoPro has ever made. There's a new family of modular lenses and it can shoot up to 5.3K and handle 2X optical zoom.</p> <span id="end-legacy-contents"></span>
<p>
 </p> 
<p>The battery is bigger than ever before and offers around 90 minutes of continuous shooting in 4K/30FPS. The camera is waterproof up to 10 millimeters, so don't worry about puddles. The full-color front screen is vivid and makes it easy to review footage without getting a computer involved.</p> 
<p>There's no internal storage here, but it accepts microSD cards. There's a camera bundle on sale right now that includes a 64GB microSD, three batteries, a dual charger and a case. That pack <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:GoPro;elmt:;cpos:4;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=06fa1f29-e83c-49e4-81a8-9732450da8a9&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=04598562-b569-4148-b80c-9d6909156167&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=GoPro&amp;linkText=costs+%24349&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAZcF4fVsbAnbK4tb5PhkDE67bYNXzo0VHGz7JOtal009&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fgopro.com%2Fen%2Fus%2Fshop%2Fcameras%2Fbuy%2Fhero13black%2FCHDHX-131-master.html%3Foption-id%3DCHDRB-134-master" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://gopro.com/en/us/shop/cameras/buy/hero13black/CHDHX-131-master.html?option-id=CHDRB-134-master">costs $349</a>, which is a <a data-i13n="elm:affiliate_link;sellerN:Amazon;elmt:;cpos:5;pos:1" href="https://shopping.yahoo.com/rdlw?merchantId=66ea567a-c987-4c2e-a2ff-02904efde6ea&amp;itemId=amazon_B0FKR7PG9W&amp;siteId=us-engadget&amp;pageId=1p-autolink&amp;contentUuid=04598562-b569-4148-b80c-9d6909156167&amp;featureId=text-link&amp;merchantName=Amazon&amp;linkText=discount+of+30+percent&amp;&amp;signature=AQAAAXK4qvwikGol9AL10ef1ucaRhR3RAO2pEa7pROuelc9-&amp;gcReferrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amazon.com%2FGoPro-HERO13-Black-Extended-Bundle%2Fdp%2FB0FKR7PG9W%2Fref%3Dast_sto_dp_puis" class="rapid-with-clickid" data-original-link="https://www.amazon.com/GoPro-HERO13-Black-Extended-Bundle/dp/B0FKR7PG9W/ref=ast_sto_dp_puis?th=1">discount of 30 percent</a>.</p>
